verses.text: Ach in Diosal, kolineli yujto ichato wan in b'atkan t'a yich ha ha'.
Wan in b'atkan t'a yich jun te sitz'atak te jul yich swab'i, manhxa b'aj tz'emk'och tek'tek' wok. Ichato toxo ix in emk'och t'a sjulal yich ha', wanxo in skuchanb'at ha'.
Toxo ix te tzap in jaj wawaji, ix te k'e syail. Toxo ix k'e syail yol in sat yuj in maklan wil a jawi ach in Diosal.

Ix ek'b'at sb'isul heb' tzin chakanel t'a xil in jolom, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'. Toxo ix te k'echaanh sb'isul heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok. Snib'ej heb' swak' meltzaj tastak to manh welk'alok.
Ach in Diosal, ojtak wal in pital. Max yal-laj in k'ub'anel juntzanh in mul chi' t'ayach.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a smasanil, a heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, mokab' q'uixwok heb' yuj in mul. Ach ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a heb' syak'em sb'a t'ayach t'a smasanil sk'ool, mokab' takkank'e sk'ol heb' yuj in chukal.
Uuj wal, ix techaj yek' juntzanh jixjon lolonel wuuj. Maxtzak yal-laj in k'ol tzin ch'ox in sat yuj q'uixwelal.
Ichato manh in ojtakab'ilok yuj heb' wuk'tak, a na to junnhej in nun yet' heb'.
Te pitz'anoch in k'ool in ya'ilan a kajnub'. Ayik sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayach, a in jun swab' pax syail.
Ayik tzin oq'ui, tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Tato a pichul yik tzin ch'oxanel in kusk'olal swak'ochi, sk'e umnaj heb' in stzetzani.
Ha innhej tzin yal heb' tz'em k'ojan t'a spuertail chonhab'. Ha heb' uk'um anh, tzin yak' b'inaj heb' t'a sb'it.
Ha inxo pax Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach tzin awaji. Ach in Diosal, ochanh wet' tiknaik. Yuj a niwan wach'k'olal, tak'wanh t'ayin. Yujto tzach kolwajnhej wet'ok, yuj chi' ochanh wet'ok.
Kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzin chakaneli. Ichato wan in b'at t'a skal lum sok'om, ma t'a skal ha ha' jul yich, yuj chi' manh in aktejb'ati.
Manh in a cha yik'b'at ha ha'. Manh in a cha b'atkan t'a sjulal yich ha', in sattakanemlaj ta'.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin. Wach' ach a ach tik, aynhej a wach'k'olal. Kotanh k'elan t'ayin yet' a niwan ok'elk'olal.
Manh in a patikejel a in a chekab' in tik, tak'wanh t'ayin t'a elanhchamel yujto ay smay b'aj ay in ek' tik.
Kolineli, nitzkot a b'a t'a in tz'ey. Kolinel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Tik wal ojtak heb' tz'alan lolonel ya t'ayin. Ix in ixtaxel yuj heb', q'uixawk'olal waji, manhxo in animaok t'a sat heb'. Ojtak wal mach heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ix ixtaxb'at in pensar yuj b'uchwal lolonel. Manhxo animaok waji, manhxalaj wip swab'i. Nab'anhej ix in say mach tz'ak'an sniwanil in k'ool yet' mach tz'ok' sk'ool t'ayin.
Ix yak'b'at veneno heb' t'a skal in wael. Ayik ix takji in ti', a vinagre ix yak' heb' wuk'ej.
Ochokab' jun sq'uinh heb' chi' syaalilok. Telwokab' heb' yuj jun sq'uinh chi'.
Mokxob' yal-laj yilan heb' uuj. Luklonokab' xub' heb' yuj manh ipal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ak'kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb'. Yamchajokab' heb' yuj a k'ak'alk'olal.
Kanokab' tzinan b'aj kajan heb'. Manhxaokab' mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Yujto tzin spech b'eyek' heb' a in tzin ak' kus tik. Sb'uchwajpax heb' t'ayin a in tzin ak' echnaj tik.
Tz'akan tzutej ak'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' icha smojal yuj chukal sk'ulej heb'. Manhxaokab' yalan yik heb' t'a kolnab'il tzak'a'.
Suksat sb'i heb' t'a yol ch'anh libro yik k 'inal. Manh ak'kanem sb'i heb' t'a yol ch'anh libro yik heb' tojol sb'eyb'al t'a ichanh.
Ha inxo pax tik jun, penaay in, ayin och t'a kusk'olal. Ach in Diosal, ik' in k'e waan, kolin.
Ach in Diosal, ol ach in b'itej yet' wach' lolonel. Ol ach in b'itej t'a ak'oj yuj diosal.
Mamin Jehová, ol ach te tzalaj yuj in b'it chi' t'a yichanh pax to a junok nok' ek'um wakax swak' in silab'ok t'ayach.
Ayik ol yilan heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' anima to ix in a kolo', ol tzalajb'ok sk'ool heb'. Hanhejtona' ol tzalajpax heb' syak'em sb'a t'ayach ach in Diosal.
Ach Jehová, tzab' tas syal heb' meb'a'. Max a patikejel-laj heb' a chonhab' ayoch t'a preso.
Masanil tas pitzan t'a satcha'anh, t'a sat lu'um yet' t'a yol ha' mar, b'itanokab' t'ayach.

Ach ko Diosal, a ach ol a kolel chonhab' Sion, ol a b'oanxi b'aj ixtaxnak juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá. Ha heb' yuninal heb' a chekab' ol kajnaj t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Hata' ol kajnaj heb', ol och heb' aj chonhab'il. Ha heb' tzach xajanani, ol kajnaj heb' t'ay.
